title.zh: 解释（交通权申请证书费用）命令 2011
title.en: Interpretation (Fee for Traffic Rights Application Certificate) Order 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Interpretation (Fee for Traffic Rights Application Certificate) Order 2011 and shall come into operation on 10th June 2011.

heading.en: Fee for Traffic Rights Application Certificate

text.en: 2. A fee of $3,500 shall be payable to the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore when an application is made under regulation 2F(3) of the Air Navigation (Licensing of Air Services) Regulations (Cap. 6, Rg 2) and for which a Traffic Rights Application Certificate may be issued.
